subject: A user's message last week stopped me cold
preview_text: I wasn't going to share this, but it changes everything about why I built this app. You need to see it.
body_paragraphs: Got an email last Tuesday at 2 AM. A user, Sarah, wrote me a single paragraph. She said she'd been about to drop her master's program. The blank page anxiety was so bad she'd missed three deadlines. Then she used the app. She finished her thesis draft in one night. She wrote, 'You gave me back my future.' I sat there staring at my screen for ten minutes.

That's the thing. I built this to save time, to get grades from B+ to A-. I didn't realize it was saving people from quitting. From believing they weren't smart enough. That's the real secret. The panic, the imposter syndrome—it's not a personal failure. It's a signal your process is broken. And 50,000 students have fixed theirs.

The feature Sarah used wasn't magic. It was the 'Outline to Full Paper' mode. She plugged in her messy notes, hit generate, and in minutes had a structured draft. It broke the paralysis. The blank page was gone. She could finally think. That's the hack: start with something, anything, and let the app build the skeleton. The writing becomes filling in the muscles.

Open the app right now. Don't stare at your document. Go to the 'New Project' tab and use 'Outline to Full Paper' on your next assignment. Just dump your thoughts in. Let it build the frame. Your job is just to make it sound like you. P.S. Sarah submitted her thesis yesterday. She's graduating. That could be your email next month.
cta_text: Open Thesis Generator & Use Outline Mode
